node_5.description: This is Rachel Nguyen's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, head to school and begin teaching at 8:30 am, have lunch at 12:00 pm, resume teaching and finish the school day by 3:30 pm, run errands, including grocery shopping and picking up household supplies, from 3:45 pm to 5:00 pm, return home and spend time with family from 5:15 pm to 6:30 pm, prepare and have dinner with family from 6:30 pm to 7:30 pm, spend time grading papers and preparing lesson plans from 7:30 pm to 9:00 pm.
